name: vision_analyze
description: Look at images or a video. A model that can see them gets the media attached directly; otherwise a vision model describes it. Accepts local paths or http(s) urls. Video (mp4/mkv/mov/webm/mpeg) needs a video-capable model and local files are capped at 200 MB.

images.description: Several in one call; overrides image.

prompt.description: Question or instruction. Defaults to a concise description.
